Hi Elena,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Kyteware looks like a good fit for the customer data enrichment pilot. Procurement needs a couple of standard artifacts to complete vendor activation and issue a PO: 

1) Executed DPA (we prefer DocuSign) or confirmation you can accept our DPA as attached.
2) SOC 2 Type II report or a hosted read-only link to the report and auditor contact.
3) Full subprocessor inventory (names, purpose, country, and a simple contact).
4) Billing details for the PO: legal entity name, remit-to address, tax ID, invoice email and any required invoice line-item language (e.g., product codes).

We also have a couple of specific asks for terms: our procurement team typically issues net-30 POs. Kyteware asked about net-45 during the call — can you confirm whether that requires an approval or if you can accept net-30? If you need net-45, flag that now so we can route for approval.

I attached our standard DPA for reference (Redwood_DPA_v2.1.pdf). If you can get the SOC2 link and the subprocessor sheet back by end of day Friday, we can aim to have a PO over the following week.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
